## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Scope

- [ ] Documentation / repository maintenance only
- [ ] C++ controller / locomotion behavior
- [ ] Evaluation / analysis semantics
- [ ] Experiment protocol / acceptance criteria
- [ ] Upstream-derived simulator/runtime code
- [ ] Other

## Research-semantic impact

State whether this PR changes the meaning of an existing experiment, metric, protocol, or scientific claim. If yes, identify affected artifacts and the new version/protocol boundary.

## Validation

List build targets, tests, simulator runs, analyses, or documentation checks performed.

## Provenance

For research-semantic changes, record relevant commit/config/data/evaluator/result identifiers.

## Checklist

- [ ] Upstream attribution and licensing remain intact.
- [ ] Failed/superseded research evidence remains traceable where relevant.
- [ ] Scientific claims are bounded by the actual evidence.
- [ ] No host-specific paths, credentials, or private artifacts were introduced.
- [ ] Frozen protocols/acceptance criteria were not silently modified.
